comment: Independent source design: uhitm.c mhitm_ad_slim calls muse.c munslime; with no carried cure, an intelligent mobile monster can move to an adjacent FIRE_TRAP and burn away slime. Scout hero inventory and open adjacent room terrain before potion polymorph and trap creation. C-only setup correction: polycontrol is not a supported startup option; preserve that rejected setup. Obtain actual polymorph control from its ring instead. C-only continuation: own inventory ring e, polymorph potion f. Place a fire trap beneath hero, step north, wear control ring and quaff polymorph selecting green slime, then create a sleeping captain. Scout actual monster placement before attacks. C-only terrain correction: trap creation on the starting upstair failed. Own map shows ordinary floor one tile east; place trap there, then stand north of it. Green slime has no eyes, so use known adjacent sleeping placement with directional force attacks rather than claim visual feedback. Source-guided material variation: armored captain negated the sliming magic attack before the rn2(4) selection. An unarmored stone giant has no equipped magic-cancellation armor and remains an intelligent mobile monster with enough HP for the cure. Keep the same independently scouted adjacent fire trap and attack protocol.
